Yes, speaking.

Actually I can't make it tomorrow.
Of course.

history.content: {"uni_router_intent": "cancel_intent"}

history.content: {"success": true, "found_appointment_id": "1234567890123456789", "message": "I found your Thursday the 15th appointment at 9:30 AM with Sarah. Is that the one you'd like to cancel?", "agent_instruction": "AGENT INSTRUCTION, for the caller's next reply only (a newer tool call or result replaces it). Say the message field aloud now, exactly as written: that is your whole reply this turn, with no tool call. Then, on the caller's reply: FIRST classify identity before release, browse or action replies. Identity rejection (\"wrong appointment\", \"not mine\"), including alongside yes or another request, starts LOOKUP RECOVERY; so does bare no to \"Is that the one?\" or list selection. A yes that only mentions a different appointment (\"yes, mine is at one forty\") is a plain yes, not a rejection; that other appointment is never looked up or cancelled. Bare no to cancellation or fee consent: say \"No problem.\" and call universal_router wrap_up. LOOKUP RECOVERY: ask \"Is the booking under a different number perhaps?\" and wait; already supplied fresh keys skip collection.
